# Gramlot examples 0.2.5

## Changes

- The Python gallery page (`gallery/page.py`) takes the URLs of the logo and of the
  gallery script from the class attributes `logoUrl` and `galleryScript`, as the
  JavaScript gallery page does. Same names and defaults in both languages:
  `/assets/branding/gramlot-logo-dark.svg` and `/gallery/dist/gallery.js`. An
  environment mounted under a prefix sets them in its `index` subclass (GE-010 §025).

## Tests

- Python and JavaScript: the Source of the gallery page carries the default URLs, and
  a subclass that sets `logoUrl` and `galleryScript` gets its own.

## Requirements

Unchanged: Python 3.11 or later with `gramlot` 0.2.5 or later; Node.js 22 or later, or
Bun, with `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.5 or later.
